title: OpenAI Nears $30B Raise at $1.25T Valuation Led by UAE Investors
summary:
The maker of ChatGPT has submitted a confidential filing to go public and expects a listing in 2027, according to internal communications from CFO Sarah Friar. The company is now finalizing a private funding round of up to $30B led by investors from the UAE and Coatue. This capital raise carries a $1.25T pre-money valuation, a decrease from the $1.4T benchmark previously targeted. OpenAI intends to secure signatures for the round by the end of next week, positioning the investment as an opportunistic bridge to its eventual market debut.

The accelerated fundraising is designed to lock in commitments before rival Anthropic's scheduled mid-November IPO to avoid direct financial comparisons once public filings are released. OpenAI is also negotiating a commercial agreement with the UAE to expand its computing capacity. The firm is pitching investors on $50B in annualized revenue, targeting $70B by year-end, to justify the new valuation over the $852B it reached in March.

OPENAI IS REPORTEDLY NEARING A FUNDING ROUND OF UP TO $30 BILLION AT A $1.25 TRILLION VALUATION

Investors from the UAE are leading the round alongside Coatue, per CNBC

And it's being positioned as a bridge to something bigger

OpenAI has already filed confidentially to go public, and CFO Sarah Friar has told employees a listing will likely come in 2027.

The $1.25 trillion is a pre-money valuation, meaning it doesn't include the new capital being raised. OpenAI told investors Thursday that it aims to secure signatures by the end of next week, and the final size of the round is still being determined.

OpenAI is also negotiating a commercial deal with the UAE that would secure more computing capacity as it expands.

selectedTweets.text:
Reuters: OpenAI is racing to raise about $30B at a valuation above $1.4T before Anthropic goes public. 

That would put OpenAI at least 64% above the $852B valuation it reached in March. 

Both labs court overlapping long-only and sovereign wealth funds, and OpenAI wants commitments before Anthropic’s filings invite side-by-side comparisons.

Those comparisons are messy: OpenAI books revenue net of partner shares, while Anthropic counts the full value of sales through cloud providers. 
Locking in $1.4T before Anthropic’s public S-1 and mid-November debut spares OpenAI a direct comparison now

Anthropic’s third-quarter revenue rose 45% to $16.8B after more than doubling in the second, and the slowdown has some investors arguing for $1.5T instead of $2T. 

Investors say OpenAI needs cash for infrastructure commitments in case a market that erased $1.6T from chip stocks in under 2 weeks further delays its 2027 listing.
